name: Holy Land (restaurant, grocery, bakery and hummus plant)
neighborhoodOrCity: Central Ave. NE near Lowry Ave., Northeast Minneapolis
whatItIs: Palestinian family business founded by Wajdi Wadi in 1986 or 1987 (sources differ); restaurant, halal butcher and grocery, bakery and hummus manufacturing sold to Twin Cities grocers.
evidence: Its own site (holylandbrand.com) returned a server error on Oct. 31, 2026. Kowalski's 2026 deli-partner page still lists Holy Land hummus, which shows the product line continues, but no opened page showed current restaurant hours. It is no longer listed among Midtown Global Market merchants.

name: Saffron
whatItIs: Chef Sameh Wadi's Levantine and Palestinian restaurant, first open 2007 to 2016, reopened in 2026 in the former Young Joni space.
evidence: Own site lists current hours (Sun-Wed 5-10 p.m., Thu-Sat 5-11 p.m.); Racket, Sept. 1, 2026, reports it has opened.

name: Baba's Hummus House & Mana'eesh Bakery
whatItIs: Cafe 'inspired by our Palestinian heritage' serving hummus bowls and brick-oven mana'eesh.
evidence: Own site lists address and daily hours; Sahan Journal listed a Baba's x Mizna iftar there on Feb. 26, 2026.

name: Wally's Falafel, Hummus and Bakery
whatItIs: Palestinian-owned falafel and shawarma restaurant; owner Wally Sakallah says each table represents a city in Palestine.
evidence: Own site posts daily hours and dine-in and catering menus dated 2026.

name: Pangea Market
whatItIs: Halal grocery with fresh halal meats, daily-baked bread and an olive and cheese deli (Nabulsi, Akawi, labneh); Palestinian-owned according to The Heavy Table (2024).
evidence: Own site states it is open daily 9 a.m. to 10 p.m.

name: The Golden Nuts
whatItIs: Palestinian-owned shop for roasted nuts, dried fruit, knafeh and baklava, opened April 2024 by Mahmoud 'Joe' Rammouni.
evidence: Own site shows products but no dated post or hours; latest opened coverage is The Heavy Table, Aug. 9, 2024.

name: Yemeni Cuisine
neighborhoodOrCity: Central Ave., Columbia Heights / Hilltop area
whatItIs: Yemeni restaurant reviewed in The Heavy Table's 2024 Central Avenue update.
evidence: Only source opened is the Aug. 9, 2024, Heavy Table newsletter; no own site found.

name: Al Amir Bakery
whatItIs: Bakery and grill known for Iraqi-style pocket bread, kebabs and kunafa.
evidence: Only opened source is a 2015 Heavy Table review; alamirbakery.com is a parked domain.

name: Qamaria Yemeni Coffee Co. (Little Canada)
whatItIs: Franchise of a Michigan-based Yemeni coffee chain, opened May 2024 by cousins Mohamed Hagi and Ibrahim Haji Said; first Yemeni coffee shop in the Twin Cities.
evidence: Opened sources are from June 2024; the chain's locations page returned 404 and its home page did not list the Minnesota shop.

name: Haraz Coffee House (Minneapolis)
whatItIs: Franchise of a Dearborn-founded Yemeni coffee chain, run by franchisee Hussein Alobaidi.
evidence: Hoodline, July 2026, reports a soft opening through July 9, 2026; Zabihah listing shows daily hours.

name: Mim's Cafe
neighborhoodOrCity: Near the University of Minnesota St. Paul campus
whatItIs: Mediterranean and Palestinian restaurant; owner Mahmoud Shahin's family fled the West Bank in 1948.
evidence: Latest opened source is Minnesota Daily, Feb. 27, 2024; own site could not be reached.

name: Shish
whatItIs: Palestinian-owned restaurant serving breakfast to dinner, per Minnesota Daily (2024).
evidence: Latest opened source is Minnesota Daily, Feb. 27, 2024.

name: Zait & Zaatar (St. Paul)
whatItIs: Palestinian-owned market and deli serving dishes such as musakhan, per Minnesota Daily (2024). Not the same as the Anaheim, Calif., restaurant of the same name.
evidence: Latest opened source is Minnesota Daily, Feb. 27, 2024.

name: Moroccan Flavors
whatItIs: Moroccan restaurant opened by chef Hassan Ziadi with Neighborhood Development Center support after he moved to Minneapolis in 2013.
evidence: Not in Midtown Global Market's merchant list checked Oct. 31, 2026; own site could not be reached.

name: Dar Medina
neighborhoodOrCity: Midtown Global Market, 920 E. Lake St., Minneapolis
whatItIs: Shop selling handmade Moroccan home goods.
evidence: Listed in Midtown Global Market's current merchant directory with hours M-Sa 10 a.m.-8 p.m.

name: Shawarma Cart
whatItIs: Egyptian American-owned business serving Cairo-style street food with halal meats.
evidence: University of Minnesota supplier-diversity listing is undated.

name: Almadina Restaurant
whatItIs: Middle Eastern and Mediterranean restaurant; owners' background not stated.
evidence: Downtown Rochester directory listing, undated.

name: Emily's Lebanese Deli
whatItIs: Lebanese deli opened in 1973 by Emily Awaijane (covered in depth in the Lebanese profile).
evidence: Own site returned a page title on one attempt but no readable hours; Northeaster history article is undated.

name: Zakia's Deli
whatItIs: Lebanese deli opened in 2007 by Zakie Maalouf and her son.
evidence: Only opened source is the undated Northeaster history article.

name: Falastin
whatItIs: Palestinian deli opened May 2024 by Lyla Abukhodair.
evidence: Northern News Now, May 6, 2025: permanently closed as of May 3, 2025.

name: Mizna
type: media / arts nonprofit (literary journal, film festival)
whatItIs: Arab and SWANA arts organization founded 1999; publishes the journal Mizna and Mizna Online and produces the Twin Cities Arab Film Festival.
evidence: Events page lists programs on Nov. 2 and Nov. 18, 2026; 2026 film festival held Sept. 23-27.

name: New Arab American Theater Works
whatItIs: Theater company producing SWANA and Arab American plays; hosts the Yalla Drum Arabic percussion ensemble.
evidence: News page reports a Yalla Drum performance in Winona in September 2026 (also The Winonan, Sept. 2026).
